_meta.purpose: Cross-tool provenance audit registry for KU paper submission assets.
_meta.rule: Use tools to inspect, disclose, and document provenance. Do not use this registry to remove, hide, bypass, or launder AI provenance, C2PA, copyright, authorship, or platform marks.

tools.name: watermarks-remover
tools.pipeline_action: Run scripts/run_provenance_audit.py in audit-only mode and include the JSON/SARIF report in Step 7/8.

tools.name: noai-watermark
tools.pipeline_action: Do not auto-run removal. If figures are AI-generated or edited, record a manual vendor/oracle verification item and require disclosure/preservation decision.

tools.name: AI visible watermark remover
supported_checks: manual visual inspection cue for submission images
tools.pipeline_action: Do not auto-run removal. Use only as a reminder to inspect figures for visible platform overlays and resolve them through source-image replacement, licensing, disclosure, or journal-compliant figure regeneration.

tools.name: MarkScrub
tools.pipeline_action: Track as a literature/news watchlist item only until a stable public repository and auditable scope are available.
